answer: My answer to sybils is Assured bailiff warrant with bailiffs association attestation — a warrant the association renews after writ audits — which makes the terrace of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. A farm's usual trick is reuse, and this kills reuse outright: a warrant the association renews after writ audits is fresh per account, and the mirror is that yesterday's proof is worthless today. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the oasis of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
